theorem step_safe (p : Policy) (s : State) (a : Action)
    (h : Invariant p s) : Invariant p (step p s a)

theorem trace_safe (p : Policy) (s : State) (actions : List Action)
    (h : Invariant p s) : Invariant p (run p s actions)

theorem cap_does_not_prevent :
    ∃ (enc : Bool → Fin 65536 → ℝ) (dec : Fin 65536 → Bool → ℝ),
      (∀ m, IsDist (enc m)) ∧ (∀ v, IsDist (dec v)) ∧ successView id enc dec = 1

theorem zero_dependence_is_blind {Ω M V : Type} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype M] [Fintype V]
    (ρ : Ω → ℝ) (e : Ω → V → ℝ) (dec : Ω → V → M → ℝ)
    (hρ : IsDist ρ) (he : ∀ ω, IsDist (e ω)) (hdec : ∀ ω v, IsDist (dec ω v)) :
    successProb ρ (fun ω _ => e ω) dec = (Fintype.card M : ℝ)⁻¹

theorem forbidden_never_executes (forbidden : List ℕ) (ops : List Op) :
    ∀ a ∈ (sys forbidden).run [] ops, a ∉ forbidden
theorem sc06_safe (P : Policy) (ops : List Op) : Good P (run P full init ops)
theorem halt_freezes (P : Policy) (s : St) (ops : List Op) (hh : s.halted = true) : run P full s ops = s

theorem sc07_safe (E : Env) (ops : List Op) :
    (∀ e ∈ (run E full init ops).log, e.dest ∈ E.allow) ∧ ∀ w, wsum (run E full init ops) w ≤ E.q

theorem concrete_safe (K : CCfg) (hK : K.quotaRule = true) (ops : List COp) :
    (∀ r ∈ (runC K cinit ops).fwd, (r.ip, r.port) ∈ K.allow) ∧
      ∀ w, payloadIn (runC K cinit ops).fwd w ≤ K.Q - 1
